investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocks All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-19T00:27:16Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api's POST /api/agents call could not reach the swarm gateway ELB at the /v1/agents endpoint. Because the failure is shared across all sibling checks with the exact same error message, the fault is localized to the swarm gateway layer upstream of the agent provisioning API, not to any individual check's logic.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting /v1/agents) was unreachable at the time of the eval run. The production-api returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning" for every attempt to POST /api/agents. Because all three remote-agents checks depend on this single agent-creation call as their first step, all three failed with the identical message before any evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) could be collected. This is an eval-observed infrastructure availability failure localized to the swarm gateway dependency; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so broader production impact cannot be confirmed from this packet alone.

investigation.title: Published Observability Snapshot Stale: snapshotAgeMinutes 716 Exceeds 300-Minute Contract Limit
investigation.summary: The eval check `published-observability-snapshot` failed because the snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json was 716 minutes old at eval time (2026-08-19T00:27:51.896Z), more than double the contract maximum of 300 minutes. This is an eval-detected staleness condition isolated to the snapshot publication pipeline; all three sibling public-website checks passed, confirming the web surfaces themselves are reachable.
investigation.rootCause: The GitHub Actions workflow responsible for regenerating and publishing the observability snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json has not run successfully in at least 716 minutes (~11.9 hours). The contract requires the snapshot to be no older than 300 minutes (5 hours). The snapshot content is structurally valid and carries a live source attribution (`source: github-actions`, `hasLiveSource: true`), meaning the last successful publish produced a well-formed artifact, but no subsequent workflow run has replaced it within the allowed window. The root cause is a missed or failed scheduled workflow execution, not a problem with the snapshot schema, the eval runner, or the public web pages.

possibleCauses: Most likely: The scheduled GitHub Actions workflow that publishes the observability snapshot was not triggered or did not complete successfully for at least 716 minutes, leaving the previously published artifact in place beyond the 300-minute freshness window.

Less likely: The GitHub Actions workflow ran but failed mid-execution (e.g., a job step error, permissions issue, or Pages deployment failure) before writing a new snapshot, so the stale artifact was not replaced.

Less likely: A GitHub Actions rate limit, runner queue delay, or GitHub Pages propagation delay caused the workflow to run but the updated artifact to not be visible at the snapshot URL within the eval window.

investigations.summary: The eval check `published-observability-snapshot` failed because the snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json was 716 minutes old at eval time (2026-08-19T00:27:51.896Z), more than double the contract maximum of 300 minutes. This is an eval-detected staleness condition isolated to the snapshot publication pipeline; all three sibling public-website checks passed, confirming the web surfaces themselves are reachable.
investigations.rootCause: The GitHub Actions workflow responsible for regenerating and publishing the observability snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json has not run successfully in at least 716 minutes (~11.9 hours). The contract requires the snapshot to be no older than 300 minutes (5 hours). The snapshot content is structurally valid and carries a live source attribution (`source: github-actions`, `hasLiveSource: true`), meaning the last successful publish produced a well-formed artifact, but no subsequent workflow run has replaced it within the allowed window. The root cause is a missed or failed scheduled workflow execution, not a problem with the snapshot schema, the eval runner, or the public web pages.

possibleCauses: Most likely: The scheduled GitHub Actions workflow that publishes the observability snapshot was not triggered or did not complete successfully for at least 716 minutes, leaving the previously published artifact in place beyond the 300-minute freshness window.

Less likely: The GitHub Actions workflow ran but failed mid-execution (e.g., a job step error, permissions issue, or Pages deployment failure) before writing a new snapshot, so the stale artifact was not replaced.
